    a = torch.cos(x)
    b = torch.sin(y)
    return torch.tanh(a) - b - a

    attn_out = self.self_attn(query=x, key=x, value=x, key_padding_mask=src_key_padding_mask)
    x = self.norm1(x + self.dropout1(attn_out))
    ffn_out = self.ffn(x)
    x = self.norm2(x + self.dropout2(ffn_out))
    return x

    attn_out = self.self_attn(query=x, key=x, value=x, key_padding_mask=src_key_padding_mask)
    x = self.norm1(x + self.dropout1(attn_out))
    ffn_out = self.ffn(x)
    x = self.norm2(x + self.dropout2(ffn_out))
    return x

def forward(self, x: Tensor, src_key_padding_mask: Optional[Tensor]=None) -> Tensor:
    attn_out = self.self_attn(query=x, key=x, value=x, key_padding_mask=src_key_padding_mask)
    x = self.norm1(x + self.dropout1(attn_out))
    ffn_out = self.ffn(x)
    x = self.norm2(x + self.dropout2(ffn_out))
    return x
